data.long_meaning: The name आकाश comes from the Sanskrit word 'akasha' meaning 'sky' or 'space'. In Hindu mythology, Akash is one of the five fundamental elements and represents the sky or ether, the boundless expanse of space. It is also associated with the divine qualities of wisdom, clarity, and truth. The name आकाश carries the meaning “Sky, Space” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose आकाश usually hope their child will grow to embody sky, space and live with faith, good character and purpose.
